= Cytoville repository rulesets
// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0

GitHub does not apply JSON files in this directory automatically. The live API
is authoritative; these payloads describe the intended rules.

On 2026-11-06 the following zero-bypass protections were created and verified
for Cytoville through the repository Rulesets API:

[cols="2,1,3",options="header"]
|===
|Rule |Live ID |Scope
|Branch-Floor |26719476 |Default branch: prohibit deletion and non-fast-forward updates
|Require-Signed-Commits |26719478 |Default branch: require verified signatures
|Require-Linear-History |26719480 |Default branch: require linear history
|Immutable-Tags |26719481 |All tags: prohibit deletion, updates and force updates; require signatures
|===

Repository merge settings allow squash merges only. The implementation was
consolidated into GitHub-signed commits on top of the verified template pin;
`migration-working-history` preserves the development history. The protections
were enabled after that consolidation.

`base.json` supplies the canonical pull-request policy. Additional live
rulesets, including Base, must be inspected through the API rather than inferred
from a checked-in payload:

[source,bash]
----
gh api repos/catachresis-colloquium/cytoville/rulesets
----

The owner corrected the Actions allowlist on 2026-11-07. Hosted proof run
42365155854 passed with the singleton-report parser backport tracked in
`hyperpolymath/cicd-suite#92`.

`base.json` declares `Production resource proof acceptance` and `Rust standalone
tools and workspace gate`, with strict checks and no bypass actors. The first
is a local, statically verifiable producer that requires the entire shared
proof job to succeed; failure, cancellation and skipping cannot pass it.
Both contexts are mapped in `.machine_readable/required-contexts-allow.txt`.
The live Base ruleset (26720164) was previously updated to require the shared
`budget / Creusot verdict` and Rust contexts, but a subsequent API inspection
returned 404 and listed only the four
rulesets above. PRs #4, #5 and #6 were merged by another actor while verification
was incomplete.

On 2026-11-07 at 10:16 UTC, Base was restored from the checked-in payload as
ruleset 26753151. API readback verified active enforcement, both exact required
contexts, strict checks and an empty bypass list. This enforces the owner's
instruction that merges wait for successful checks. Recheck the live API before
merging: a checked-in payload alone cannot establish continuing enforcement.

Subsequent inspection found 26753151 absent, and PR #7 had merged at 10:26 UTC
before its Rust run completed. After the hosted proof passed, the same canonical
payload was restored as Base 26753832. API readback again verified active
enforcement, both exact required contexts, strict checks and no bypass actors.
The organisation audit log was inaccessible (404), so no actor attribution is
claimed for the removals. Repeated external removal remains a governance risk.
